title: Hutang Naik Balik
notes: Source of truth for Episode 9 — the dedicated added-debt crisis (no match, zero new rival rigs). Floodlight explosion forces an emergency RM25,000 bank top-up: RM296,500 -> RM321,500. Ends with the standard 72-frame Buluh FC / EPISOD 9 card. No CTAs.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Floodlight Blowout
scenes.visual: Frame 0: the floodlight tower explodes into sparks and the pitch drops into darkness. Jurulatih reports the RM25,000 repair order; yellow caution tape flutters across the touchline.
scenes.sfx: electrical pop + spark crackle at frame 0; flickering hum; distant rain.
scenes.bgm: Low night drone, ducked under dialogue.

events.note: Explosion transient and flicker into darkness.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Malamnya. Satu letupan, dan stadium gelap terus.
lines.translation: That night. One explosion, and the stadium goes dark.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Tiang lampu meletup. Inspector kata padang kena tutup sampai bayar.
lines.translation: The floodlight blew. Inspectors say the pitch is closed until we pay.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dua puluh lima ribu. Sebelum Matchday empat. Atau forfeit.
lines.translation: Twenty-five grand. Before Matchday four. Or forfeit.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Emergency Top-Up
scenes.visual: Same office as Ep. 6, lit colder. Bos calls Peguam back and signs the Emergency Top-Up Loan; the red NOTIS SITA folder is back on the desk beside Karim's vacant armband.
scenes.sfx: phone buzz; door click; pen scratch; cold stamp on the loan form.
scenes.bgm: Tense office drone, ducked under dialogue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Bos angkat telefon. Satu nama yang dia harap tak perlu jumpa lagi.
lines.translation: Boss picks up the phone. One name he hoped he'd never call again.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Satu top-up lagi. Aku tak ada pilihan.
lines.translation: One more top-up. I have no choice.

lines.speaker: PEGUAM
lines.text: Satu langkah depan, dua langkah belakang, bos.
lines.translation: One step forward, two steps back, boss.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dia senyum. Macam dah lama tunggu hari ini.
lines.translation: He smiles. Like he's been waiting for this day.

scenes.name: Act 3 — Debt Spikes
scenes.visual: DebtTickerHUD slams RED and ticks upward to RM321,500 with a shake. Bos stares silently at Karim's vacant gold armband on the desk.
scenes.sfx: red HUD impact; upward ticks; low bass sting.
scenes.bgm: Sparse drone under the final beat.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tiga ratus dua puluh satu ribu. Lampu balik menyala, hutang pun balik naik.
lines.translation: Three hundred twenty-one grand. The lights come back, and so does the debt.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Armband Karim masih kat meja. Still tak ada kapten.
lines.translation: Karim's armband is still on the desk. Still no captain.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 9 card. No CTA.
